definitions.full: H1414. gedad [ גְּדַד ] verb hew down ( ᵑ7 J ; Syriac (rare); Biblical Hebrew cut ); — Pe`al Imperative masculine plural אִילָנָא גֹּ֫דּוּ (K § 46, Beisp, a ) Dan 4:11 ; 4:20 .
